task.description: Hard gate on lib/letflow/design/req209-expr-differential-corpus-regression.md. CODE-DESIGNER classified all 15 corpus entries as EVALUATED (0 EXPECTED_UNSUPPORTED) -- this is a specific, checkable claim: independently re-read the actual corpus file at c:/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/R-Co/tests/differential/corpus/conditions_v1.json (absolute path, sibling repo) and lib/letflow/engine/expr.ex's actual supported-grammar boundary (@unsupported_call_markers, and whatever else the grammar excludes -- macros, type-conversion functions, collection functions, bare `in`, ternary) yourself, and verify each of the 15 entries' condition_text genuinely contains no unsupported construct, rather than accepting CODE-DESIGNER's own classification.
